programme.title: Behind The Scenes of WOLONG: The Mastermind Ep04 ((Behind The Scenes of WOLONG: 大师mind Ep04))
programme.desc: Go behind the scenes of WOLONG: The Mastermind, as the director, producer cast share how ancient wisdom meets the modern world in a story of strategy, suspense, power struggles the human heart. (站在WOLONG的幕后:大师作为导演、制片人分享了古老的智慧如何在战略、悬念、权力斗争中与现代世界相遇。)

programme.title: A Romance of the Little Forest Ep35 ((两个人的小森林 Ep35))
programme.desc: Starring Zhang Bin Bin Yu Shu Xin, this modern romance drama is about a fashion blogger who schemes to use her beauty to retaliate against the man who once rejected her. (一位时尚博客计划利用她的美貌报复曾经拒绝她的男人。)

programme.title: Flourished Peony Ep01 ((国色芳华 Ep01))
programme.desc: Set in Tang Dynasty, the story is about He Weifang, a flower craftsman who is good at cultivating rare peonies, overcoming adversity her extraordinary business acumen.

programme.title: Yang Sudi Tinggal Ep05 ((帅哥露丁丁 Ep05))
programme.desc: From national athlete to educator, discover Emilys story and how Astro is changing her future. (从国家运动员到教育者, 发现艾米丽斯的故事和星体是如何改变她的未来。)

programme.title: Legend Of Zang Hai Ep34 ((藏海传 Ep34))
programme.desc: Zang Hai, the sole survivor from a tragic downfall, dedicates himself to mastering architectural craftsmanship and strategic diplomacy to uncover the truth, avenge his family, and uphold justice. (唯一幸存于悲剧性倒塌的尚海,致力于掌握建筑工艺和战略外交,以揭露真相,为家人报仇,维护正义。)

programme.title: Yang Sanggup Berjuang Ep09 (杨尚古贝珠)
programme.desc: Karamjit Singh reflects on serving his country, in this Astro 30th anniversary tribute. Thank you, Karamjit, and to all our athletes and veterans, for your service. (卡拉米吉特·辛格在30周年纪念仪式上反思他为他的国家服务的情况。 感谢卡拉米吉特和我们所有运动员和退伍军人,感谢你的服务。)

programme.title: Overdo Ep32 ((主播女孩重度依赖 Ep32))
programme.desc: The story follows the chance encounter between Mu Rong Qing Yi, the cold scion of a prominent family, and Ren Su Su, an orphan driven by a quest for vengeance after suffering profound abuse. (故事是继一个显赫家庭的冷血后裔Mu Rong Qing Yi与在遭受严重虐待后寻求复仇的孤儿Ren Su Su的偶然遭遇之后。)

programme.title: Breakfast In China S5 Ep02 ((早餐中国 S5 Ep02))
programme.desc: Journey from China to Malaysia and Vietnam to discover Chinese breakfasts filled with resilience, warmth, and everyday spirit. Each dish a small story that nourishes and brightens every morning. (旅行从中国到马来西亚和越南,发现中国早餐充满了弹性,温暖和日常精神.)

programme.title: The Shaolin Avengers ((八国联军))

programme.title: The Duel ((怪兽雄师))

programme.title: Five Elements Ninjas ((五遁忍术))
programme.desc: When evil ninjas brutally slaughter students from a noble Chinese kung-fu academy, the one survivor forms a powerful group to avenge his fallen comrades. (当邪恶的忍者残忍地屠杀了中国贵族功夫学院的学生,)

programme.title: Whose Baby Is in the Classroom? ((女校春色))
programme.desc: Inoue Umetsugus last Shaw film before his untimely death is a testament to the auteurs carefree comic talent. (在他早逝之前,伊诺伊·乌梅图古斯的最后一部电影是作者无忧无虑的漫画才能的证据.)

programme.title: Clan Feuds ((大旗英雄传))
programme.desc: Adapted from a book by Ku Lung, this spectacular martial arts showcase features an all-star cast including Ti Lung, Lo Mang, Ai Fei and Lily Li. (这部电影是从库隆的书中改编的, 壮观的武术表演中包括Ti Lung,Lo Mang,Ai Fei和Lily Li.)

programme.title: West Chamber ((西厢艳谭))
programme.desc: Based on a famed Chinese opera, this melodramatic film depicts the romance between Zhang Sheng, an impoverished scholar, and Ying Ying, who is from a wealthy family. (这部电影是以中国著名歌剧为基础的, 描绘了贫困学者张申和来自富裕家庭的英之间的浪漫情节.)

programme.title: Judgement of an Assassin ((决杀令))
programme.desc: This tale of the 100 Poison Cliques obsessive ambition to destroy all rivals climaxes in a bloody clash involving a mass murderers trial. (这一故事关于100个毒品小伙子的痴迷的野心, 摧毁所有竞争对手,)

programme.title: Empress Wu ((唐朝禁宫秘史))
programme.desc: This splendid, award-winning film features Li Li Hua as the Empress Wu Tse-tien, the most powerful woman in Chinas four thousand year history. (这部电影中,李扮演了中国四千年的历史上最强大的女皇.)

programme.title: Twin Blades of Doom ((阴阳刀))
programme.desc: A man who left the martial world returns to action and goes on the road to vengeance after the evil Ghost Gang kills his parents. (一个离开武力世界的人回到行动, 走向复仇的道路,)

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion ((八国联军))
programme.desc: The Empress Dowagers use of the Boxers to remove the foreign powers from China yields unexpected results. Starring Alexander Fu. (爵夫人杜瓦格斯使用拳击手去除外国力量从中国产生意想不到的结果.)

programme.title: Crazy Nuts of Kung Fu ((鬼马两金刚))
programme.desc: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to steal a huge amount of money from a warlords home when they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. (一名路边强盗和一个游客徒团队, 偷走了巨额的钱,)

programme.title: Back Home ((七月返归))
programme.desc: Wing, who can see ghosts since young, discovers that the visions that once haunted him have become worse in his home. Caught between the living and dead, Wing must bring the truth to light to be free. (翼从小就能看到鬼魂,它发现曾经困扰着他的幻觉在他家中变得更糟。 翼在生死之间被困住,翼必须把真理引向光明,才能自由。)

programme.title: American Girl ((中文))
programme.desc: During the SARS outbreak in 2003, a teenage girl struggle to adjust to life in Taipei after returning from LA, due to her mothers sickness her younger sisters misdiagnoses with SARS.

programme.title: Call Me Agent ((我要做特務))
programme.desc: Miu Ling, who dreams of becoming a secret agent, accidentally rescues an injured spy. He agrees to make her his apprentice, turning her upside down as she goes on madcap adventures. (梦想成为一个秘密特工的灵意外地救出了一个受伤的间. 他同意让她成为他的学徒,)

programme.title: Tales from the Occult ((失衡凶间之恶念之最))
programme.desc: An anthology of 3 horrifying tales a singer spirals when spooky things happen in her home a livestream ends with an influencers death the battle between residents a creature in the stairwell.

programme.title: Measure In Love ((他年她日))
programme.desc: A massive quake splits the world into two zones with different time speeds. Medical student An Qing meets a boy named Shu Zai, yet with every reunion, he ages rapidly while she remains unchanged. (一场大规模的地震将世界分为两个不同时间速度的地区。 医科学生安清遇到了一个叫舒宰的男孩,但每次团聚,他都会很快长大,而她没有变化。)

programme.title: Burning Blood ((热血燃烧))
programme.desc: A police betrayal has resulted in the death of a narcotics squad member during the arrest of a drug lord. As other team members uncover the truth, they are torn between loyalty and betrayal. (警方背叛了一名毒品团员,在逮捕一名毒品主管时,他死亡.)

programme.title: Soul Mate ((灵魂伴侣))
programme.desc: July and An Shengs strong friendship is put to the test when they encounter a guy, Su Jia Ming, sparking a love triangle that alters both their destinies. (和安的友受到考验,当他们遇到一个人,苏贾明,)

programme.title: I Did it My Way (我以自己的方式做到了)
programme.desc: As the secretive dark world of online drug trafficking increasingly targets Hong Kong, the police launches a risky and secret operation to bring down one of the most notorious drug lords in Asia. (由于网络毒品贩运的秘密黑暗世界越来越多地准香港,)

programme.title: Someone Like Me (像我这样的人)
programme.desc: Ah Mei, bound by cerebral palsy and her mothers push for a forced hysterectomy, finds love with Ken through a disability intimacy service. Together, they forge a tender bond that defies all barriers.

programme.title: Moscow Mission ((警察学校7：进军莫斯科))
programme.desc: A Chinese police officer disguises as a businessman takes charge of an operation to arrest the criminals who perform a heist on the train, but uncovers a bigger conspiracy instead... (一名中国警察伪装成一个商人,负责逮捕在火车上抢劫的罪犯的行动,)

programme.title: Hit N Fun ((临时决斗))
programme.desc: Ad executive Lin uncovers her boyfriends affair with a champion boxer and challenges her to a match. Under the former boxing legends training, her quest for revenge evolves into self-discovery. (广告高管林揭示了她与一名拳击手冠军的男友关系,并挑战她参加比赛.)

programme.title: The Invisible Guest ((看不见的客人))
programme.desc: Joanna is a suspect of a locked-room murder where her lover is found dead. When the police investigates the case, they discover another murder case which leads them to the truth. (乔纳是被怀疑的锁房谋杀案,她的情人被发现死了. 当警察调查这个案例时,他们发现另一个谋杀案,)

programme.title: Let It Ghost ((打架吧鬼神))
programme.desc: Featuring 3 urban ghost stories a famous actor is haunted after he hit a girl while driving a taxi driver is being drained dry by a ghost a ghost child wanders a soon-to-be demolished mall.

programme.title: Limbo ((丛林地狱))
programme.desc: After accidentally killing veteran detective Zhans wife, Wang Tao seeks redemption by assisting Zhan in tracking a serial killer. However, her involvement puts her in grave danger. (道在意外杀死老侦探斯的妻子后,通过帮助斯追踪一名连环杀手来寻求赎回.)

programme.title: The Unwavering Brotherhood ((扎职3：义薄云天))
programme.desc: Hua, Fei and Guo are robbed when transporting gang money. When Hua discovers that Fei and Guo are connected to the robbery, he must choose between loyalty and brotherhood. (当华发现和与抢劫有关,他必须选择忠诚与兄弟关系.)

programme.title: Love Is The Only Answer ((人约离婚后))
programme.desc: When a flash of her grooms infidelity is revealed at their wedding, Bo cancels the entire affair. However, within a year, he comes knocking on her door again. (在他们的婚礼上,布奥发现了她的未婚夫的不忠,)

programme.title: My Indian Boyfriend (我印度男朋友)
programme.desc: The first Bollywood movie made in Hong Kong, it is about an interracial love story between a Hong Kong girl and an Indian boy! Faced with many difficulties, can their love prevail? (香港拍摄的第一部波利时电影,是关于香港女孩和印度男孩之间的跨种族爱情故事!)

programme.title: Detective Dee and Nine-storey Demon Buil (探偵迪和九層樓魔鬼建築)
programme.desc: Detective Dee investigates a series of strange incidents at Tangs building, finding the master suspicious when even his eldest daughter secretly tells Dee of his odd behavior. (探偵迪在唐斯大樓調查了一系列奇怪事件, 發現主人懷疑, 即使是他的長女秘密地告訴迪他的奇怪行為.)

programme.title: A Gilded Game ((猎金游戏))
programme.desc: A finance interns rapid rise under a top analyst ends when he betrays his mentor for a rival. To redeem himself and stop a hostile takeover, he must seek help from the man he wronged. (金融实习生在顶级分析师的领导下迅速升级,他背叛他的导师为竞争对手.)

programme.title: The Chinese Feast ((金玉满堂))
programme.desc: Sun moves to Canada to become a chef but struggles with his skills but must represent the restaurant in a contest. Seeking help from a legendary chef, Sun fights to achieve his dream. (孙搬到加拿大成为厨师,但他不太擅长,但必须代表餐厅参加比赛.)

programme.title: Kung Fu Hustle ((功夫))
programme.desc: This award-winning film directed, written and starred in by Stephen Chow, depicts the adventure of a wannabe gangster who aspires to join the notorious Axe Gang. (这部由斯蒂芬·乔夫导演,写作和主演的获奖电影描绘了一个想成为帮派的冒险,)

programme.title: Haunted Mountains: The Yellow Taboo ((山忌：黄衣小飞侠))
programme.desc: A photographer and his friends enter a remote mountain, unaware its a forbidden area. Soon, a boy in a yellow raincoat appears, and eerie events begin to unveil the mountains ancient curse.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood ((宝贝计划))
programme.desc: A trio of thieves kidnaps a baby for ransom, then becomes his unlikely guardian after discovering a deadly plot against the child. (三个小偷绑架一个婴儿以勒索赎金, 在发现一个针对孩子的致命阴谋后,)

programme.title: One More Chance ((多一次机会))
programme.desc: Chow Yun-Fat plays the unlucky gambler Chui Sui-Fai, whose ex-girlfriend asks him to take care of their autistic son. He reluctantly agreed and the two slowly begin to build their relationship. (乔-法特扮演了不幸的徒楚伊苏伊-法伊,他的前女友要求他照顾他们的自闭症儿子.他不愿意同意,他们慢慢开始建立他们的关系.)

programme.title: The Choice of Gen Z II the Innovation of China Ep04
programme.desc: The youth of a country is the future of that country. A series of documentaries focusing on the younger generation of China in which you get to see what they are achieving and what makes them tick! (纪录片系列讲述中国年轻人,)

programme.title: The Sichuan Zhuqin
programme.desc: A well-crafted collage of selected short documentaries telling stories about all aspects of China! People, technology, culture, and wildlife, all are showcased in Internet-friendly form. (精心制作的短片纪录片,讲述了中国各个方面的故事!)

programme.desc: A strand devoted to the nature and wildlife of China, the people who lived alongside them, and the great and diverse landscapes with which they all contend. (专注于中国的自然和野生动物,)

programme.title: The Singing Killer
programme.desc: Chiang Yi is blackmailed into a jewellery heist by his former boss who threatens to expose his shady past. Complications arise when Chiang Yi discovers his first love working in the jewellery store.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gamblers apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: Martial Club
programme.desc: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other. This is Director Liu Chia Liangs masterpiece and one of the top ten highest grossing movies in 1981.

programme.title: Gamblers Delight
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywoods famous Beach Party movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach

programme.title: The Shaolin Avengers
programme.desc: Hu seeks to avenge his father who is being killed by the White-Browed Hermit and his gang. However, he fails in his attempt and is saved by Fang Shi Yu, a youth from Shaolin whose parents are also killed by the same villains. They learn and master the advanced Shaolin style kung fu, before Fang leads Hu and the Shaolin fellows to fight the enemies.

programme.title: My Name Aint Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: The Flying Dagger
programme.desc: The Yu family and the Green Dragon clan became enemies when the Yu daughter killed the clan heads son, who was a rapist and murderer. The Green Dragon leader wounds the head of the Yu family with his flying daggers, and a wandering swordsman saves the family using his own flying dagger skills. However, his allegiances and motives are unclear.

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demons clutches.

programme.title: The Singing Thief
programme.desc: A master jewel thief turns over a new leaf as a professional singer in a nightclub. However, a series of robberies happened shortly after and he becomes the suspect again. The thief then sets up a trap to snare the copycat but will this backfire on him?

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return...

programme.title: Wits Of The Brats
programme.desc: Nan Tou Kuan, a spoiled but talented young heir from Guangdong, is sent to Beijing by his mother to find a bride and mature. Along the way, he befriends three rogues: a cardsharp, a ladies man, and a master thief. Together, they must outwit the sinister Three-Eyed Taoist, who plots to seize the familys fortune.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
programme.desc: Three young men offend a billionaire and are drawn into a high stakes bet. If they win, they get to keep the billionaires Rolls Royce. Otherwise, they will need to pay the rich man fifty thousand dollars! Will the underdogs win the bet?

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires or fake ones!.

programme.title: The Duel
programme.desc: After knowing his brother has killed the head of a rival triad, Jie takes the blame and was hunted by killers. With the help of Rambler Nan, Jie finally killed his enemies, but then found out that Nan is the one who has killed his father.

programme.title: Five Elements Ninjas
programme.desc: After a Japanese samurai is defeated and commits seppuku, ninja lord Chin leads his clan to China for revenge. They challenge martial arts leader Yuan with the deadly Five Elements Ninja Formation, wiping out his unprepared disciples. The survivors must master the enemys techniques to break the formation and avenge their comrades.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls high school, is stuck with a baby that isnt his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Tie Zhong Tang, adopted son of Da Chi Men leader Yun Yi, is hunted by rival Situ Xiao, who seeks the clans hidden treasure. To uncover its secrets, Tie journeys to Changchun Island to find the legendary Ri Hou. Instead, he finds Ri Hou dead and discovers the clans founder, Ye Di Tie Yi, is his real father.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her familys objection, so Hongs maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Judgement of an Assassin
programme.desc: An evil clan plans a discord so as to dominate the martial arts world. Their masked assassins massacre another clan and one of the assassins is arrested and brought to trial at a tribunal of all the clans. What judgement will they make and can they uncover the truth?

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperors death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Twin Blades Of Doom
programme.desc: A retired martial artist is forced to return with a vengeance after his family and friends are murdered by the evil Ghost Gang. He decides to challenge the gangs leader to a deadly duel so as to take revenge. Can he defeat the ruthless leader in the end?

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Crazy Nuts Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to make money from gambling. In a successful attempt to steal a huge amount of money from a warlords home, they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. Will the two help the revolutionists cause with the stolen money?

programme.title: Infernal Affairs III
programme.desc: Ming is transferred to do menial police work ten months after the murder of Yan, in 2004. Meanwhile, a new star, Wing, has emerged in the police force and Ming suspects he is also a mole sent by the triad. Determined to start anew, Ming must kill Wing while ensuring his own identity does not get exposed.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from The Sutra of 42 Chapters.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Clouds successor as the citys guard.

programme.title: The Sorcerer The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snakes true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laikas mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandoras box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandoras Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its Cop Shop Babes as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Openthe Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror her father is peeping at night and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kongs Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Lis daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords
programme.desc: Drug lord Jizo joins forces with Mexican cartels, throwing Hong Kongs drug underworld into chaos. Determined to eradicate narcotics, billionaire Yu Shun Tin offers a HK100 million bounty on drug traffickers while concealing a dark bond with Jizo. As their shared past resurfaces, an explosive showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey2-Cinderella
programme.desc: Following the chaos unleashed by Pandoras Box, Joker is thrust through time and begins to awaken as the Monkey King, Sun Wukong. Torn between mortal emotions and divine destiny, he struggles to reconcile his love for Zixia Fairy with the responsibilities of his past.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

It is the meeting point of both the highly influential and rising voices, facilitated by host, Tian Wei. Every Monday to Friday, it provides nutrition to form your own thoughts and ideas through live debate and interviews.

programme.desc: 戲子沈慕靈為追查師父離奇死亡的真相，結識了外表玩世不恭內心滿懷熱血的富家公子關行楷，兩人從最初的相互猜忌試探，到後來並肩作戰，在繁華鬧市的硝煙暗湧中，利用梨園戲台傳遞情報；他們不僅查明了真相，更在家國危難之際挺身而出，如星星野火般在亂世中燃燒自己，守護心中大義.

programme.title: 勿擾飛升短劇 Flying Up Without Disturb Mini drama
programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師.

programme.title: 探寶說創團 Treasure Creators Troupe

programme.title: 大使的廚房 Ambassadors Kitchen

programme.desc: 薛家强林峯饰完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报刑事情报科总督察章纪孜黄智雯饰怀疑卓凯苗侨伟饰出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希蔡思贝饰及保安局调查官韦作荣马国明饰，合力捣破涉案集团保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂袁伟豪饰加入，接管刑事情报科的工作覃欢喜许绍雄饰逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强卓凯等展开报复.

programme.title: 碧血盐枭 Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远马浚伟为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪杨怡的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚郭峰之子胡亭轩黄浩然相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨......胡亭轩为助窦胜雪忘却不快，安排她在胡府经营的盐栈工作，而窦胜雪为报答胡亭轩救命之恩，不计劳苦为盐栈出心出力，那段日子令胡亭轩对窦胜雪由怜生爱，却碍于恶疾缠身，一直未敢表白，直至窦胜雪的二叔突然现身，暴露了窦胜雪的真正身份，胡亭轩为防家人报官竟向窦胜雪提亲......

programme.title: 八卦神探 Officer Geomancer
programme.desc: 薛丹仁李思捷是一名普通警员，但他非等闲之辈，因他在玄学上深得外公真传，每每在关键时刻，为许多奇案破解谜团，加上黑白通吃的好友梁醒裘梁烈唯作线人，其出众的作风常令上司车季菲万绮雯啧啧称奇，季菲拥有犯罪心理学专家资格，事事只凭理性，二人看似南辕北辙，但内里却因合作蕴酿了一种不能言语的默契，但季菲一副管家婆模样，工作以外只关心妹妹车季美杨诗敏和弟弟车季君郑俊弘的终身大事，当季美陷入醒裘和下属铁良芷朱晨丽的三角关系时，季菲情绪失控，幸得丹仁出手相助此际，城中发生连环失踪案，诱拐手法勾起了丹仁隐藏多年的往事，季菲不惜以身犯险，丹仁却算到.

programme.title: 巨轮 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 乔天生（陈展鹏饰）和罗威信（萧正楠饰）是同母异父的亲兄弟，因为命运令他们不单分开在香港和澳门两地，更令他们尝尽剧变历史中的两极冲突 母亲周玉梅（李司棋饰）带着小儿子威信在澳门当黑市居民，威信凭着努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮饰）与龙飞（阮兆祥饰）的相助，历尽艰辛，克服挑战，最终踏上成功之路独自在港自食其力的天生却改走快捷方式，联结黑道古惑仔姜勇（张继聪饰），与富家女发生关系，令女友卓静（钟嘉欣饰）伤心欲绝，最终落得人财两空 本是唇齿相依的手足情，经历时代巨轮的洗礼，前境变幻莫测，二人愈走愈远，但一个信念深植在他们相连的血脉里，纵然考验再苦再难，终在一条又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 他来自江湖 Justice Of Life, The
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生明天与母亲舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋.

programme.title: 丫鬟大联盟 Handmaidens United
programme.desc: 以兵部侍郎裘府丫鬟月盈黄心颖饰为首的六部丫鬟组成联盟，互通消息，一起赚钱月皎汤洛雯饰为筹钱给爱郎傅有为谢东闵饰上京赴考，卖身为婢月盈与月皎分别服侍大夫人官之姵郭少芸饰和二夫人上官云英张慧仪饰，各为其主，互相斗法！少爷裘其进洪永城饰与月盈情投意合，可惜遭父裘正郑子诚饰打压裘正犯事被降职，其进决心考取功名，重振家声兵部尚书霍奔潘志文饰之女霍燕贞刘思希饰也看上有为，多番引诱月盈月皎害怕情郎高中后失去对方，誓要他们状元梦碎两对恋人面临决裂之际，竟卷入卖国漩涡中.

programme.desc: 薛家强林峯饰完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报刑事情报科总督察章纪孜黄智雯饰怀疑卓凯苗侨伟饰出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希蔡思贝饰及保安局调查官韦作荣马国明饰，合力捣破涉案集团保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂袁伟豪饰加入，接管刑事情报科的工作覃欢喜许绍雄饰逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强卓凯等展开报复.

programme.title: 碧血盐枭 Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远马浚伟为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪杨怡的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚郭峰之子胡亭轩黄浩然相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨......胡亭轩为助窦胜雪忘却不快，安排她在胡府经营的盐栈工作，而窦胜雪为报答胡亭轩救命之恩，不计劳苦为盐栈出心出力，那段日子令胡亭轩对窦胜雪由怜生爱，却碍于恶疾缠身，一直未敢表白，直至窦胜雪的二叔突然现身，暴露了窦胜雪的真正身份，胡亭轩为防家人报官竟向窦胜雪提亲......

programme.title: 八卦神探 Officer Geomancer
programme.desc: 薛丹仁李思捷是一名普通警员，但他非等闲之辈，因他在玄学上深得外公真传，每每在关键时刻，为许多奇案破解谜团，加上黑白通吃的好友梁醒裘梁烈唯作线人，其出众的作风常令上司车季菲万绮雯啧啧称奇，季菲拥有犯罪心理学专家资格，事事只凭理性，二人看似南辕北辙，但内里却因合作蕴酿了一种不能言语的默契，但季菲一副管家婆模样，工作以外只关心妹妹车季美杨诗敏和弟弟车季君郑俊弘的终身大事，当季美陷入醒裘和下属铁良芷朱晨丽的三角关系时，季菲情绪失控，幸得丹仁出手相助此际，城中发生连环失踪案，诱拐手法勾起了丹仁隐藏多年的往事，季菲不惜以身犯险，丹仁却算到.

programme.title: 丫鬟大联盟 Handmaidens United
programme.desc: 以兵部侍郎裘府丫鬟月盈黄心颖饰为首的六部丫鬟组成联盟，互通消息，一起赚钱月皎汤洛雯饰为筹钱给爱郎傅有为谢东闵饰上京赴考，卖身为婢月盈与月皎分别服侍大夫人官之姵郭少芸饰和二夫人上官云英张慧仪饰，各为其主，互相斗法！少爷裘其进洪永城饰与月盈情投意合，可惜遭父裘正郑子诚饰打压裘正犯事被降职，其进决心考取功名，重振家声兵部尚书霍奔潘志文饰之女霍燕贞刘思希饰也看上有为，多番引诱月盈月皎害怕情郎高中后失去对方，誓要他们状元梦碎两对恋人面临决裂之际，竟卷入卖国漩涡中.

programme.desc: 薛家强林峯饰完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报刑事情报科总督察章纪孜黄智雯饰怀疑卓凯苗侨伟饰出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希蔡思贝饰及保安局调查官韦作荣马国明饰，合力捣破涉案集团保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂袁伟豪饰加入，接管刑事情报科的工作覃欢喜许绍雄饰逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强卓凯等展开报复.

programme.title: 碧血盐枭 Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远马浚伟为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪杨怡的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚郭峰之子胡亭轩黄浩然相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨......胡亭轩为助窦胜雪忘却不快，安排她在胡府经营的盐栈工作，而窦胜雪为报答胡亭轩救命之恩，不计劳苦为盐栈出心出力，那段日子令胡亭轩对窦胜雪由怜生爱，却碍于恶疾缠身，一直未敢表白，直至窦胜雪的二叔突然现身，暴露了窦胜雪的真正身份，胡亭轩为防家人报官竟向窦胜雪提亲......

programme.title: 八卦神探 Officer Geomancer
programme.desc: 薛丹仁李思捷是一名普通警员，但他非等闲之辈，因他在玄学上深得外公真传，每每在关键时刻，为许多奇案破解谜团，加上黑白通吃的好友梁醒裘梁烈唯作线人，其出众的作风常令上司车季菲万绮雯啧啧称奇，季菲拥有犯罪心理学专家资格，事事只凭理性，二人看似南辕北辙，但内里却因合作蕴酿了一种不能言语的默契，但季菲一副管家婆模样，工作以外只关心妹妹车季美杨诗敏和弟弟车季君郑俊弘的终身大事，当季美陷入醒裘和下属铁良芷朱晨丽的三角关系时，季菲情绪失控，幸得丹仁出手相助此际，城中发生连环失踪案，诱拐手法勾起了丹仁隐藏多年的往事，季菲不惜以身犯险，丹仁却算到.

programme.title: KLTV 2026

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Aisyah dapat merasakan kubur itu adalah sesuatu yang sangat bermakna dalam hidupnya. Perasaan dia menjadi sebak dan tak mampu di bendung lagi. Aisyah memohon maaf kepada Ros kerana tidak dapat mengingati siapa Ros tetapi dia dapat rasakan Ros juga merupakan seseorang yang bermakna dalam hidupnya. Kepulangan Aisyah dan Iskandar ke Kuala Lumpur mengejutkan mereka dengan persediaan majlis persandingan yang dilakukan oleh Tengku Maria dan Tengku Yusuf. Aisyah membantah hal itu dan meminta majlis itu tidak di teruskan. Iskandar cuba memujuk Aisyah dan berjanji akan membawa keluarga baharu Aisyah untuk meraikan mereka bersama. Aisyah bersetuju tetapi dia memberi syarat kepada Iskandar untuk memberinya keizinan supaya dia dapat pulang ke kampong halaman seorang diri untuk menjemput keluarga Mak Su Ainin dan Ros. Berat untuk Iskandar lepaskan kerana dia tahu akan bahayanya Aisyah jika dia kembali ke rumah Mak Su Ainin. Namun ketegasan Aisyah untuk membatalkan majlis persandingan itu jika Iskandar tidak memberi keizinan membuatkan Iskandar terpaksa akur. Iskandar mengekori Aisyah tanpa pengetahuan Aisyah. Di kampong, Mak Su Ainin dan Fasha mengambil kesempatan terhadap Aisyah. Niat baik Aisyah untuk menjemput mereka turut serta membuahkan bermacam penghinaan terhadap diri Aisyah sehingga Aisyah jatuh sakit. Ros adalah orang yang menyelamatkan Aisyah dan terpaksa menghubungi Iskandar bagi memaklumkan hal itu.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Talia meniti saat akhirnya. Dia mengucapkan terima kasih dan meminta maaf atas perlakuannya. Syarfan turut memohon maaf atas sikap ibunya. Talia menghembuskan nafas terakhir di pangkuan Antasya. Syarfan sering pulang awal untuk menjaga Antasya kerana tarikh melahirkan bayi semakin hampir. Antasya bahagia.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Qasih menyahut cabaran untuk menjadi isteri yang solehah dengan mengemas rumah dan memasak untuk suaminya. Jazlan pula merasakan yang beliau gagal menjadi seorang suami yang baik kerana tidak dapat membentuk isterinya menjadi isteri yang solehah. Masakan yang dimasak Qasih melalui youtube menyebabkan Jazlan bangun di tengah malam dan bergegas ke bilik air, keesokannya Jazlan sakit kepala dan demam. Salah seorang pelajar Arab yang dibimbing Jazlan menghantarkan nasi arab ke rumah yang membuatkan Qasih cemburu dan sakit hati kerana beliau telah mula mencintai Jazlan. Setelah keadaan sebenarnya diterangkan Qasih dan Jazlan mula bermesra dan bergurau senda menjalani kehidupan sebagai suami isteri dengan penuh bahagia

Salah seorang pelajar Arab yang dibimbing Jazlan menghantarkan nasi arab ke rumah yang membuatkan Qasih cemburu dan sakit hati kerana beliau telah mula mencintai Jazlan. Setelah keadaan sebenarnya diterangkan Qasih dan Jazlan mula bermesra dan bergurau senda menjalani kehidupan sebagai suami isteri dengan penuh bahagia

programme.title: Ekspresi Fesyen
programme.desc: Ekspresi Fesyen minggu ini host Aqilah Azali akan berbual fesyen bersama penyanyi Lia Aziz.. Akan berkenalan dengan pereka fesyen disebalik label pakaian MisClair juga kita akan disajikan dengan segala macam info yang menarik tentang Fesyen.

programme.title: Ijab Kabut
programme.desc: Gambar Khai melamar Deanna tular di media sosial dan Deanna kini dianggap curang. Deanna cuba memulihkan keadaan tetapi sedar dia tidak akan jumpa jalannya selagi tidak menjawab satu soalan: Adakah dia akan memilih Mat atau Khai?

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Farah tidak mampu lagi memaafkan Lukman apabila sekali lagi bertembung dengan Myra di dalam rumah Lukman. Seluruh kepercayaan sudah lerai. Dia keluar dari rumah dan enggan berjumpa dengan Lukman lagi. Dia sanggup tinggal di hotel demi menjauhkan diri daripada semua orang. Lukman resah apabila tidak dapat mencari Farah namun hal itu disembunyikan daripada familinya. Segalanya berpunca daripada Myra yang datang ke rumah demi mengadukan konon dirinya teraniaya. Pihak pengurusan syarikat mendapat bukti bahawa Lukman terbabit dalam kehilangan wang syarikat. Abah tidak percaya dengan tindakan Farah yang nekad ke UK meninggalkan suami dan Zahin. Budi mengesyaki ada yang tak kena dengan kes Lukman. Farah pula menanggalkan cincin perkahwinan lalu diserahkan kepada Lukman. Dia sudah redha apa sahaja jalinan takdirnya. Lukman ditahan polis untuk siasatan kes pecah amanah.

programme.title: Ronda Roda
programme.desc: Ronda Roda kali ini, menampilkan kereta Chery, Tp Autoworks dan Cefiro. Yang dihoskan oleh Mira Rizam dengan mempamerkan kereta baru dari Chery Omoda 5 dan hasil tangan dari Fazreen along dan Syuk.

programme.title: Aroma Masak
programme.desc: Hani Fadzil selaku hos musim ini akan menyediakan 2 menu istimewa iaitu Ayam Kicap Pedas Piza Pratta sambil ditemani oleh artis jemputan, Fahimi Rahmat.

programme.title: Misteri Mona Ku Serumu Kembali
programme.desc: Selepas Mona dilepaskan demi menyelamatkan anaknya, Anom dirawat di pusat psikiatri dan mengawal Mona sepenuhnya. Dakwaan pembunuhan rupanya halusinasi, menimbulkan persoalan tentang kebenaran sebenar di sebalik delusi Mona.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Aisyah dapat merasakan kubur itu adalah sesuatu yang sangat bermakna dalam hidupnya. Perasaan dia menjadi sebak dan tak mampu di bendung lagi. Aisyah memohon maaf kepada Ros kerana tidak dapat mengingati siapa Ros tetapi dia dapat rasakan Ros juga merupakan seseorang yang bermakna dalam hidupnya. Kepulangan Aisyah dan Iskandar ke Kuala Lumpur mengejutkan mereka dengan persediaan majlis persandingan yang dilakukan oleh Tengku Maria dan Tengku Yusuf. Aisyah membantah hal itu dan meminta majlis itu tidak di teruskan. Iskandar cuba memujuk Aisyah dan berjanji akan membawa keluarga baharu Aisyah untuk meraikan mereka bersama. Aisyah bersetuju tetapi dia memberi syarat kepada Iskandar untuk memberinya keizinan supaya dia dapat pulang ke kampong halaman seorang diri untuk menjemput keluarga Mak Su Ainin dan Ros. Berat untuk Iskandar lepaskan kerana dia tahu akan bahayanya Aisyah jika dia kembali ke rumah Mak Su Ainin. Namun ketegasan Aisyah untuk membatalkan majlis persandingan itu jika Iskandar tidak memberi keizinan membuatkan Iskandar terpaksa akur. Iskandar mengekori Aisyah tanpa pengetahuan Aisyah. Di kampong, Mak Su Ainin dan Fasha mengambil kesempatan terhadap Aisyah. Niat baik Aisyah untuk menjemput mereka turut serta membuahkan bermacam penghinaan terhadap diri Aisyah sehingga Aisyah jatuh sakit. Ros adalah orang yang menyelamatkan Aisyah dan terpaksa menghubungi Iskandar bagi memaklumkan hal itu.

programme.title: Ijab Kabut
programme.desc: Dua minggu sebelum majlis dan impian perkahwinan Deanna semakin pudar. Adakah kisah dongeng Deanna akan berakhir dengan kekecewaan?

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Sepanjang berada di UK, Farah diasak rindu terhadap Lukman dan Zahin. Dia sibukkan diri dengan studi demi melupakan segala kemelut yang melanda di samping menjaga kandungannya yang makin membesar. Farah tidak tahu bahawa Lukman ditahan di lokap. Berita kematian Mama akibat heart attack bukan sahaja merentap jiwanya, malah meragut seluruh kebahagiaan keluarga. Lukman dihambat penyesalan tak berkesudahan. Zulkarnain ikat jamin dan menyelesaikan segala tuntutan syarikat untuk membebaskan Lukman. Liza dan Nazim seumpama tulang belakang yang sentiasa menyokong Farah di Manchester. Farah terkejut apabila Lukman tiba-tiba muncul di depan pintu apartment untuk memohon maaf kepadanya. Farah tidak sanggup berdepan dengan Lukman hingga menyebabkan mereka bertengkar. Tanpa sengaja, Farah tergelincir dan terjatuh di tangga hingga mengalami pendarahan.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Maisarah dan Airel merancang masa depan bersama selepas mendapat tawaran kerja. Walau bagaimanapun, bapa Airel, Datuk Muiz, merancang secara rahsia untuk menjodohkan Airel dengan Damia tanpa pengetahuan mereka.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Sebelum melahirkan anak Antasya memohon maaf atas segala kesalahannya kepada Syarfan. Bayi mereka selamat dilahirkan dan dan Isabella telah menjadi penyeri di rumah. Najwan berdoa supaya dia dan Syafinaz turut menemui pengkahiran yang membahagiakan. Setelah beberapa tahun, kehadiran Hana mengejutkan mereka. Datin Jasmin telah dibebaskan dari penjara.

programme.title: Misteri Mona Ku Serumu Kembali
programme.desc: Selepas Mona dilepaskan demi menyelamatkan anaknya, Anom dirawat di pusat psikiatri dan mengawal Mona sepenuhnya. Dakwaan pembunuhan rupanya halusinasi, menimbulkan persoalan tentang kebenaran sebenar di sebalik delusi Mona.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Oleh kerana kesihatan Aisyah tidak begitu baik, Iskandar memujuk Tengku Maria untuk menangguhkan majlis persandingan itu. Tengku Maria bersetuju dengan syarat dia mahu Iskandar menjaga Aisyah dengan sebaiknya. Perubahan Tengku Maria cukup di senangi oleh Tengku Yusuf, dia mula menjalinkan hubungan yang baik bersama keluarga baharu Aisyah dan Ros. Tengku Maria juga sanggup datang ke kampong halaman Aisyah dan memberi amaran kepada keluarga Mak Su Ainin supaya tidak lagi mencederakan Aisyah. Seperti karma, Iskandar kini menjaga Aisyah yang tidak sihat sama seperti yang pernah dilakukan oleh Aisyah kepadanya. Di sebalik rasa bahagia yang dirasakan oleh Iskandar di saat dia bersama dengan wanita yang di cintainya itu, dia juga merasa sakit di sebabkan sikap Aisyah yang kasar dan langsung tidak dapat menerima kehadirannya sebagai seorang suami yang sah. Aisyah dan Iskandar bertengkar dan Iskandar meluahkan segala yang dirasanya, Aisyah kecewa melihat Iskandar yang seakan sudah berputus asa. Aisyah juga sebenarnya berusaha keras untuk mengingati Iskandar namun sering kali dirinya gagal. Hatinya kuat mengatakan dia mencintai Iskandar meskipun kelakuannya menunjukkan dia seperti tidak menerima Iskandar. Aisyah mendapat jawapan yang jelas mengaoa hatinya benar-benar mencintai Iskandar sejak pertama kali mereka berjumpa selepas Aisyah hilang ingatan. Iskandar tidak keruan, dia puas berfikir. Malam itu, Iskandar berkemas dan meninggalkan Aisyah di dalam kondo itu.

programme.title: Ekspresi Fesyen

programme.title: K-Love
programme.desc: Tish mendengar berita buruk daripada OB Gyne, dia terdorong untuk melamar teman lelaki lamanya manakala Sheila disingkirkan sebagai yang paling berjaya dalam kalangan rakan sekelas lamanya di sekolah menengah jadi dia memulakan perjalanannya untuk membuktikan dia masih mendapatnya. Jay sebaliknya pulang dari luar negara tetapi ada masalah, dia bergegas untuk keluar dari Manila ASAP.

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Farah dibawa pulang ke Malaysia setelah mengalami keguguran. Dia mengalami tekanan jiwa dan ada sindrom meroyan lantaran terlalu sedih dengan kehilangan tersebut. Dia seakan hilang siapa dirinya hingga meresahkan orang-orang di sekeliling. Namun, dia menafikan bahawa dirinya sakit. Musibah yang menimpa menyebabkan Farah semakin membenci Lukman meskipun Lukman sudah berusaha untuk berdamai dengannya. Joshua pula sanggup bertindak mencederakan Myra setelah Myra berterus terang dengan Lukman dan Budi mengenai apa sebenarnya yang berlaku. Nazim pulang ke kampung untuk urusan pernikahan adiknya. Farah bersungguh mahu mengikut Nazim pulang ke Manchester dan mendesak Lukman melepaskannya. Dia benar-benar tawar hati meskipun Lukman sudah insaf dan terus merayu agar Farah memberikan peluang kedua kepadanya.

programme.title: Dabbe Bir Cin Vakasi
programme.desc: Rumah sebuah keluarga di Turki dirasuk roh jahat yang ingin membunuh manusia.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP3
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah keluarga yang terlepas bas terakhir untuk ke Genting selepas perjalanan mereka terganggu. Dalam keadaan terdesak, mereka menaiki sebuah bas lama tanpa logo yang muncul tepat jam 12 malam. Antologi mengisahkan Lima pelajar universiti menemui Long Samad Que Haidar, penjaga sebuah rumah terpencil yang menceritakan kisah-kisah seram seantero nusantara.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China III
programme.desc: Tuan Wong dan pengikutnya mendaftar dalam Dancing Lion Competition untuk menghentikan plot pembunuhan dan melawan lawan yang sombong dan penipu.

programme.title: Black S2 EP4
programme.desc: Black menolong Sofia menyelamatkan seseorang yang rapat dengan Sofia tapi itu hanya menyebabkan mereka hampir maut. Semuanya tampak ada kaitan dengan runtuhan Pusat Membeli-Belah Seri Setia.

programme.title: Spirit Whisker: The Revenant
programme.desc: Seorang anak sulung keluarga kaya yang telah meninggal dunia tiba-tiba hidup semula selepas seekor kucing hitam misteri melompat ke atas mayatnya, yang membawa kepada kelakuannya yang pelik dan ganas yang menyebabkan keluarga itu huru-hara dan menimbulkan rahsia gelap di kalangan mereka.

programme.title: Sate
programme.desc: Milah ialah seorang peniaga sate dan kedai satenya terletak di hadapan bengkel kepunyaan Kadir yang suka melakukan eksperimen aneh. Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. programme.title: Duhai Si Pari-Pari

Nita menagih kasih sayang kedua ibu bapanya. Ingin bertunang dengan Idris namun ibunya ingin menjodohkan Nita bersama anak Datuk Hamzah.

programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Sate

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara

Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Gerak Khas 2.0

programme.title: Boneka

programme.title: Gerabak Cinta
programme.desc: Aiman dibawa secara terpaksa dari kampung ke rumah Zaim dan Juwita di bandar. Di sana Aiman dilayan secara kasar, tidak dihantar belajar ke sekolah, malah disuruh membuat kerja-kerja rumah. Lebih teruk apabila Aiman sering dipukul oleh Juwita.

programme.title: Reaksiar
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.

programme.title: Gila Gila Remaja 2
programme.desc: Filem ni adalah sekuel kepada Gila-Gila Remaja 1985. Ia bawa vibe remaja moden dengan konflik cinta, persahabatan, dan cabaran zaman baru. Kisahnya lebih fokus pada hidup remaja kolej sekolah memandu, dengan isu sosial yang dekat dengan golongan muda persaingan, cinta segitiga, serta impian masing-masing.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Oppa
programme.desc: Menggambarkan seorang guru yang terperangkap dalam penipuan percintaan dalam talian, mendedahkan cabaran jenayah siber di Malaysia. Usaha pihak Polis Diraja memburu penjenayah menambah elemen suspen.

programme.title: 3 Dara Pinggiran
programme.desc: 3 Dara Pinggiran mengisahkan tiga wanita dari latar hidup berbeza yang bergelut dengan cabaran hidup, cinta dan keluarga. Walaupun sering berdepan masalah dan salah faham, mereka saling menyokong antara satu sama lain dalam mencari kebahagiaan dan arah hidup masing-masing.

programme.title: 99 Cahaya Di Langit Eropa Part 1
programme.desc: Hanum dan Rangga menetap di Eropah ketika Rangga melanjutkan pengajian. Di sana, Hanum mula meneroka kisah sejarah Islam di Eropah dan bertemu Fatma, seorang Muslim Turki. Perjalanan mereka membuka pandangan tentang keindahan dan cabaran menjadi Muslim di negara minoriti.

programme.title: 99 Cahaya Di Langit Eropa Part 2
programme.desc: Hanum dan Rangga meneruskan perjalanan mereka di Eropah sambil menyelami sejarah Islam di Vienna dan Andalusia. Mereka berdepan pelbagai cabaran dalam memahami identiti, kepercayaan, dan hubungan antara budaya.

programme.title: Hantu Dalam Botol Kicap
programme.desc: Tiga kanak-kanak yang jahil melanggar peraturan di rumah nenek mereka, menyebabkan meraka terlepas bebas.

programme.title: Geran
programme.desc: Ali dan Fatimah berasa kecewa dengan adik mereka, Mat Arip, apabila dia gagal pulang dengan geran tanah pusaka mereka. Ali perlu mencari Mat Arip, yang telah bergaul dengan kumpulan yang salah dan terlibat dalam perjudian serta perlumbaan haram, lalu membawanya pulang kepada bapa mereka, Pak Nayan.

programme.title: Airmata Si Kudung
programme.desc: Sabri dan Seroja ialah adik-beradik yatim piatu. Sabri kehilangan kaki akibat serangan buaya. Apabila dewasa, Seroja berkahwin dan tinggal di bandar, manakala Sabri ditinggalkan. Kerana rindu, Sabri ingin mencari adiknya.

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia

programme.title: Dania
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Dania, seorang remaja penyendiri yang mula percaya kepada seniornya, Sarimah, dan dibantu oleh Cikgu Bahar untuk tuisyen percuma. Namun, Bahar mengambil kesempatan ke atas Dania hingga merogolnya, menyebabkan Dania trauma dan kemurungan. Abangnya, Luqman, menyedari keadaan sebenar Dania dan bersama-sama memperjuangkan kebenaran walaupun kes itu digugurkan.

Menerusi persembahan yang semakin mencabar, setiap peserta perlu menyerlahkan bukan sahaja kehebatan vokal, malah bakat seni, kebolehan serba boleh, ketahanan mental dan daya tarikan pentas. Dengan persaingan sengit serta persembahan yang memukau, hanya bintang paling menyerlah akan mara ke puncak.

programme.title: Saleha
programme.desc: Saleha mengisahkan seorang gadis baik hati yang ditinggalkan oleh ayahnya dan dibesarkan oleh nenek. Selepas diculik dan kehilangan neneknya, dia dipersalahkan dan dihalau oleh keluarganya. Dengan semangat dan keimanan yang teguh, Saleha memulakan hidup baru di Jakarta sambil menyembunyikan penyakit serius.

programme.title: Makan Terooos
programme.desc: Jelajahi kekayaan masakan yang menampilkan rasa autentik. Sertai kami dalam pengembaraan rasa di seluruh Indonesia, hanya di Makan Terooos, di mana setiap hidangan memiliki kisahnya sendiri.

programme.title: Tertawan Hati
programme.desc: Alya dan Alyssa ialah pasangan kembar yang terpisah sejak lahir. Selepas 25 tahun, takdir menemukan mereka semula, dan mereka terkejut melihat wajah yang begitu seiras. Pertemuan itu merapatkan hubungan mereka, namun tanpa disedari pelbagai rahsia dan konflik mula terbongkar, mengubah kehidupan kedua-duanya.

programme.title: Perjodohan Terpaksa Yang Berujung Derita
programme.desc: Nayla Sonya Pandarmawan telah lama bekerja di rumah Bu Ambar sejak kecil lagi. Melihat kebaikan Nayla, Bu Ambar merancang untuk menjodohkannya dengan anaknya, Aris Rexy Rizky. Namun, Aris sudah mempunyai kekasih yang rupa-rupanya pernah dilihat bersama suami kepada rakan Bu Ambar. Apakah keputusan Aris apabila kebenaran terbongkar?

programme.title: Tiba-Tiba Kuis
programme.desc: Program kuiz kejutan di tengah keramaian yang menawarkan hadiah wang tunai lumayan. Orang ramai dipilih secara rawak untuk menjawab soalan mudah, sementara reaksi spontan dan kisah menyentuh mereka dirakam bagi menghasilkan hiburan yang menyeronokkan serta penuh makna.

programme.title: DARK NUNS ((黑修女们))
programme.desc: An evil spirit possesses a boy and his life is at risk. 2 nuns embark on a dangerous ritual and are determined to save the boy at all costs, no matter the risks or consequences. (邪恶的灵魂拥有一个男孩,他的生命处于危险之中。 2名修女走上危险的仪式,决心不惜一切代价拯救男孩,不管风险或后果如何。)

programme.title: THE WHISTLEBLOWER ((告密者))
programme.desc: A disgraced Korean researcher claims to have successfully cloned human embryo stem cells. However, the results were revealed to be fabricated along with other unethical practices later. (韩国一名尬的研究人员声称成功克隆了人类胚胎干细胞.)

programme.title: THE PRIESTS (祭司)
programme.desc: After a girl is assaulted, two priests must determine if she was attacked by an evil spirit or a molester. (两个祭司要确定一个女孩被邪灵攻击了还是被强奸者攻击了.)

programme.title: HEAR ME: OUR SUMMER ((听说))
programme.desc: Yong-jun is working as a delivery man when he meets and instantly falls for Yeo-reum, the devoted sister of a gifted deaf swimmer. Yeo-reum slowly opens her heart to warm-hearted Yong-jun. (俊当遇到姆时,他就在做分发员,他立刻爱上了姆,一位有才华的聋游泳者的忠诚妹妹.)

programme.title: GYEONG-AHS DAUGHTER ((景雅的女儿))
programme.desc: After her husband passed away, Gyeong-ah relies on her daughter Yeon-su. But they barely meet each other. One day, Gyeong-ah gets an anonymous message about Yeon-su and goes into trauma... (丈夫去世后,依赖她的女儿苏,但他们几乎没有见面.)

programme.title: THE FAVOR ((相伴到永远))
programme.desc: A familys prayers are answered by a mysterious savior, but as miracles spread, they uncover a chilling truth: every gift comes with a deadly curse. (一个家庭的祈祷被一个神秘的救主回答,)

programme.title: LOVE CLINIQUE ((音痴诊所))
programme.desc: Dong-ju joins school choir for Min-soo even she is tone-deaf. They reunite 10 years later. She wants to impress him so she enrolls in a vocal training clinic where Shin-hong trains her... (东加入了明的学校合唱团,即使她是听不懂的,他们10年后再聚在一起,她想给他留下深刻的印象,所以她就进入了声学训练诊所,)

programme.title: HITMAN 2 (热门歌曲)
programme.desc: Jun is working on a new webtoon season when he receives an email with a gripping plot. He draws it, but soon real-life terrorism mirrors the storyand Jun becomes the prime suspect.

programme.title: THE SWINDLERS ((玩家))
programme.desc: Though each has their own motives, unlikely individuals from different sides of the law allies together to achieve a common goal - trapping the worlds most legendary con man. (尽管每个人都有自己的动机, 不可能来自不同法律部门的个人, 结合在一起, 实现一个共同的目标 - - 陷入世界上最传奇的骗子.)

programme.title: DARK NUNS ((黑修女们))
programme.desc: An evil spirit possesses a boy and his life is at risk. 2 nuns embark on a dangerous ritual and are determined to save the boy at all costs, no matter the risks or consequences. (邪恶的灵魂拥有一个男孩,他的生命处于危险之中。 2名修女走上危险的仪式,决心不惜一切代价拯救男孩,不管风险或后果如何。)

programme.title: TAZZA: THE HIDDEN CARD ((老千2：神之手))
programme.desc: Go-nis nephew, Ham Dae-gil, enters the gambling underworld only to be used as a scapegoat in a deal gone wrong. Now hes planning his revenge by entering one big fatal game. (戈尼斯的子汉姆·达吉尔进入了博的地下世界, 只是为了被用作赎罪羊,)

programme.title: THE KING ((七王国的骑士))
programme.desc: Believing power is paramount, Tae-soo aspires to become a prosecutor. As he achieves his goal and rises to power, he also sees the cruelty of a life at the top hierarchy in 90s Korea.

programme.title: COLLECTORS ((讨债人2))
programme.desc: A legendary treasure hidden in Seouls royal tomb sparks fierce rivalry as the exacavators and others with secret agendas race to outwit each other for the kings relics. Who will prevail? (首尔王室墓藏的传奇宝藏引发了激烈的争斗,就像挖掘者和其他有着秘密议程的人竞相为国王的遗迹相互逃避。 谁能获胜呢?)

programme.title: THREE SISTERS ((三姐妹))
programme.desc: Three sisters reunited for their fathers birthday, yet the strange action of their brother reveals their dark past. (三个姐妹在父亲的生日上再见,然而,他们的兄弟的奇怪行为揭示了他们的黑暗过去.)

programme.title: DRIVE ((舌尖上的美国))
programme.desc: Yuna is a YouTuber who is invited to a party where she drinks and falls asleep. She is then trapped in the trunk. The kidnapper asks her to do a kidnap live-stream and beg for money.

programme.title: ONCE WE WERE US ((後來的我們))
programme.desc: Former lovers Eun-ho and Jeong-won unexpectedly reunite on a flight to Korea, giving them a second chance to reminisce about their past and share long-buried words with each other. (让他们有第二次机会回想起自己的过去, 并彼此分享长久的言辞。)

programme.title: THE HOT-BLOODED ((金庸武侠世界))
programme.desc: 4 friends gave up on Taekwondo and part ways after being asked to lose on purpose in a trial. Years later, they decided to take on a local gang realizing their hometown is threatened. (经过几年,他们决定与当地的一支帮派作战,因为他们意识到自己的家乡受到威胁.)

programme.title: KINGMAKER ((风云碑))
programme.desc: A politician met a talented campaign strategist who helped him become the strongest presidential election candidate. Yet conflicts deepen as they share different ideologies.

programme.title: THE UNFAIR ((马尔科姆的一家：生活依旧不公))
programme.desc: A protest against urban renewal leads to death of a cop and a teen. The boys father was arrested for the cops death. A young attorney is assigned to defend the father. (抗议城市更新导致一名警察和一名青少年死亡.男孩的父亲被捕为警察的死亡.一名年轻的律师被任命为捍卫父亲.)

programme.title: RETURN OF THE MAFIA ((家族荣誉5：家门的归还))
programme.desc: 10 years ago, the mafia family welcomed the entrepreneur Dae-suh as the son-in-law. They set up a company and Dae-Suh becomes the president. The family plot a conspiracy against him... (10年前,黑手党的家人迎接了企业家达苏作为子,他们成立了一家公司,达苏成为总统.)

programme.title: SPLIT ((分道扬镳))
programme.desc: Cheol-jong was once a legendary bowler, but an accident ended his career. He later teams up with an autistic genius bowling player Young-hoon and bookmaker Hee-jin to make money.

programme.title: THE MAN FROM NOWHERE (没有人)
programme.desc: A quiet pawnshop keeper with a violent past takes on a drug-and-organ trafficking ring in hopes of saving the child who is his only friend. (一个安静的当铺管家 带着暴力的过去 抢走了毒品和器官贩运圈 希望能拯救他唯一的朋友)

programme.title: Fifties Professionals ((大叔再出招))
programme.desc: Three once-pros get one last chance to rebootfinally starting the real second half of their lives in their fifties (3个一对一对一的 获得最后一次机会 最终重新开始 开始他们50多岁时的下半生)

programme.desc: Lee Kwang-soo and Doh Kyung-soo are reuniting to open a cafeteria inside the production company eggiscoming. programme.title: Scoop 2026 ((2026年全国两会))
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights. (苏普在周一到周日播出,密切关注主要社会事件和有趣的故事,同时还报道了娱乐行业的最新更新,名人新闻,以及戏剧促销和幕后特色.今天 Breaking News 分类让观众了解最热门的故事.深入的特色部分探讨了公众关心的当前事件,社会和生计问题,采访相关专家以获取他们的见解.)

programme.title: Doctor is sick
programme.desc: Produced by the team behind News Hotline, this show flips the script on medical series by focusing on doctors who become patients themselves. It follows healthcare professionals as they face serious illnesses and health crises, highlighting how they handle vulnerability, diagnosis, and personal struggle behind the white coat.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021 ((天龙八部))
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026 ((全信没收))
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges. (随着大城市商店的推广,观众们可以了解到各种及时的主题,包括季节性产品,健康和健康,健身活动,护肤和化,时尚服装,婴儿护理,家长知识,当地精致食品和物护理趋势.内容是全面的!除了主持人实践示范,体验或测试外,专家也被邀请分享他们的专业见解.在菜领域,几位熟练的菜专家轮流展示简单而美味的健康菜和家庭式食谱,帮助每个人都解决风格的挑战.)

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies ((开心老友记))
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate? (许多人可能认为年长者没有性需求,但调查表明,年长者通常因各种原因而没有更多的性活动.社会福利部的临床心理学家林海明解释了世界卫生组织对性行为的定义,并为希望与伴侣重新启动性生活的人提供建议.)

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022 ((港生活·港享受 2022))
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success. programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021 ((天龙八部))
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: EXTRA ((E.T.外星人))

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021 ((天龙八部))
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge. programme.title: Big City Shop 2026 ((全信没收))
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges. (随着大城市商店的推广,观众们可以了解到各种及时的主题,包括季节性产品,健康和健康,健身活动,护肤和化,时尚服装,婴儿护理,家长知识,当地精致食品和物护理趋势.内容是全面的!除了主持人实践示范,体验或测试外,专家也被邀请分享他们的专业见解.在菜领域,几位熟练的菜专家轮流展示简单而美味的健康菜和家庭式食谱,帮助每个人都解决风格的挑战.)

programme.title: Neighborhood Treasures Sr.7 (邻居财库)
programme.desc: Sammy and Kitty, this quirky duo, reunite on screen, this time as secret agent leaders, delivering hilarious clips from Taiwan, Japan, and Hong Kong to the audience. Each episode features celebrity guests divided into two teams, each using their imagination to solve incredibly difficult puzzles related to the hilarious clips alongside the leader. They can also ask two beautiful fun agents for hints, but theyll have to judge for themselves which information is true and which is false. The worst-performing guest will receive retraining from the leaderwhat punishment awaits the guests? (Sammy和Kitty,这个在屏幕上重聚的Camimy和Kitty,这个在屏幕上重聚的,这次是秘密特工头目,从台湾、日本和香港向观众提供热闹的剪辑。每集的主角都是名人宾,分成两队,各利用他们的想象力解决与领导人一起的滑稽剪辑有关的极其困难的谜题。他们也可以请两个美丽的有趣的代理人提供提示,但他们必须为自己判断哪些信息是真实的,哪些是虚假的。最差的客人会从领导人那里得到什么惩罚?)

programme.title: Mystic Nine Whats On Today ((Mystic Nine 即将上映电影))
programme.desc: In 1933, a mysterious ghost train arrives in Changsha, prompting military commander Zhang Qishan to investigate a hidden mine containing ancient secrets targeted by Japanese forces. Joining forces with opera singer Er Yue Hong and hotel heiress Yin Xinyue, Qishan and the citys powerful Mystic Nine families must navigate deadly underground traps to solve a century-old mystery and protect their nation from invasion.

programme.title: Doctor is sick
programme.desc: Produced by the team behind News Hotline, this show flips the script on medical series by focusing on doctors who become patients themselves. It follows healthcare professionals as they face serious illnesses and health crises, highlighting how they handle vulnerability, diagnosis, and personal struggle behind the white coat.

programme.title: Gourmet Express ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors. (香港汇集全球菜,其独特的菜和精致的菜吸引了富有挑的爱好者! 食物主持人和主持人如Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong,Jessica Liu,Gillian Ng跟上最新的食物新闻和交易,深入了解味道背后的故事. 收集了各种平台的流行餐厅的第一手信息,主持人亲自排列并品尝食物,提供了真实的评论.即使没有餐饮选择的餐厅也很受欢迎.)

programme.title: Vital Lifeline ((最强生命线))
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health. (城市居民往往经历着繁忙的生活和高度压力,这使他们更容易受到健康问题的影响。最强的生命线帮助你解开健康的秘密。首先,该方案在常见的城市疼痛问题上有四大系列,包括头痛、肩部和颈部疼痛、背部疼痛和联合疼痛。每集都邀请医疗专家解释这些病症的原因,以及物理治疗师和锻炼专家进行适当的锻炼。随着东西方医学结合的趋势日益增长,甚至美国游泳冠军迈克尔·菲尔普斯也使用杯式疗法来缓解疼痛。因此,每集都包括传统的中国医学诊断,辅之以针线、杯子和Sanfu草药补丁疗法等疗法,这些疗法在最热的夏季特别合适。此外,中国医药从业人员分享了营养汤的食谱,所有这些都有助于调节和改善你的健康。)

programme.title: Big Boys Club ((Big Boys Club兄弟幫 - 外星來客))
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience. (大男孩俱乐部是一款由一群亲密朋友Bob Lam,Oscar Leung,Derek Wong,Philip Fan和Alan Chan主办的青年谈话节目.在每个集中,歌手,演员或来自不同领域的客人都被邀请进行放松的面试,介绍了包括当前社会问题,流行文化和流行兴趣在内的广泛的主题.爱情,关系甚至同性关系等问题是不止讨论的主题.该节目邀请来自不同背景的客人探索爱情和关系,深入性别之间的动态.其他维度段有客人分享非凡的经验,如遇到鬼魂,UFO和奇怪事件,将兴奋的主题带到观众.)

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021 ((天龙八部))
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Cause Of Death (死亡原因)
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sums approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun Mark Ma. The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yans buddy Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yans career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-kas death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased! (新任命的女性法医病理学家程志扬·赫拉·陈博士一直受到Lam Sum Willie Wai博士的启发。自从Chiyan博士还是个孩子以来,她一直渴望加入法医病理学处。然而,她在其上司Lam Sum博士开始新工作后被其上司Lam Sum博士所排挤。Lam Sum和他的前妻Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU高级检查员,不能站在一起。她们的女儿Lam Suet-lui离家出走,她们的道路又再次交叉。Chiyan 得到Lam Suet-lui的认可,她的工作态度是勤奋的,她与警官Ko Chun Mark Ma建立了联系。她们中的三个人逐渐成为精心协调的犯罪破坏三者。在经历了心脏病和失业之后,Chiyans兄弟Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng成为当地新闻记者。她和时髦的记者Tsim Pak-yu Nicolas Yuen从玩耍的对手发展到支持的合作伙伴。正如Chiyan的事业正在进步一样,她听到好朋友死亡的消息。她决心揭露真相并说出死亡的真相。)
