programme.title: Hai Zhi Yao
programme.desc: This historical drama follows the turbulent lives of the Ye brothers, Sun Zhongyi and Huangfu Zaiqing, alongside the three daughters of Sun Jingchuna renowned opera performer from Ziyang Street. Spanning from the War of Resistance through decades of separation across the Taiwan Strait to the modern era, the story weaves together romance, family feuds, intelligence warfare, and changing times. As the characters navigate love, heartbreak, and unexpected twists of fate, they remain tied to their shared devotion to their country and family.

programme.title: The Sound of Happiness
programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages.

programme.desc: A warm and relatable lifestyle talk show that explores the daily dynamics between mothers, daughters-in-law, and modern families. programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan dramatises folk tales, legends and local beliefs passed down through generations. Drawing on Taiwans rich cultural heritage, each story explores the lives, values and supernatural traditions of different communities.

programme.title: Back Home ((七月返归))
programme.desc: Wing has been able to see ghosts since young. When his mothers suicide attempt forces him to return to Hong Kong and the home he ran away from, he discovers that the horrific visions that once haunted him have become worse. Caught between the living and the dead, Wing must bring the truth to light to be free. (翼从小就能看到鬼魂。 当他的母亲自杀试图迫使他回到香港和他逃离的家时,他发现曾经困扰他的可怕幻觉已经变得更糟了。 翼在生死之间被困住,必须让真理被揭晓才能自由。)

programme.title: American Girl ((中文))
programme.desc: 13 year-old Fen is uprooted from LA and moves to Taipei in early 2003, when her mother is diagnosed with breast cancer. She struggles to adjust to her new life with a new school and long-separated father, and drifts away from her mother. When her younger sister is misdiagnosed with SARS, they finally open up to each other during quarantine.

programme.title: Call Me Agent ((我要做特務))
programme.desc: Miu Ling dreams of becoming a secret agent. Even though it seems impossible, she still harbours such a dream and hopes that it will soon come true. One day, Miu Ling rescues an injured secret agent who promises to make her his apprentice. From then on, her life is turned upside down and she goes onto a roller-coaster of madcap adventures.

programme.title: Tales from the Occult ((失衡凶间之恶念之最))
programme.desc: The movie consists of three tales about the horrors lurking in dark corners of the city. A young pop star goes back into depression when spooky things happen in her new home an online influencer performs live in a mall, but it ends up being a livestream of his death the residents of a tenement building battle a mysterious figure in the stairwell.

programme.title: Measure in Love ((他年她日))
programme.desc: A massive earthquake splits the world into two regions where time flows at different speeds. During a medical relief mission, student An Qing meets Shu Zai, and an extraordinary bond begins. Yet with every reunion, he ages rapidly while she remains unchanged, forcing them to confront a love challenged by time, distance, and fate. (一场大地震将世界分裂为两个时间以不同速度流动的区域。 在医疗救援任务中,安青学生与舒宰会面,并开始与众不同寻常的纽带。 然而,每次重聚,他都会在她没有变化的情况下迅速衰老,迫使他们面对时间、距离和命运挑战的爱情。)

programme.title: Burning Blood ((热血燃烧))
programme.desc: After a corrupt cop leaks their operation, four elite narcotics officers are ambushed while pursuing a cross-border drug lord. One is killed, their leader dies in the line of duty, and another vanishes without a trace. Years later, the surviving Chan Tai Wah and Low Mai reunite to expose the long-hidden mole and avenge their fallen comrades.

programme.title: Soul Mate ((灵魂伴侣))
programme.desc: July and An Sheng have been best friends since they were thirteen. They always believed their friendship would last forever, until they meet Su Jia Ming at the age of eighteen. The trio find themselves in a love triangle, which puts the girls friendship to the test and alters their destinies. (7月和安盛自13岁起就一直是最好的朋友。 他们一直相信友谊将永远持续下去,直到他们18岁时见到苏佳明。 三重奏发现自己身处三角情境,让女孩的友谊接受考验并改变她们的命运。)

programme.title: I Did It My Way (我以自己的方式做了)
programme.desc: As the secretive, complex world of online drug trafficking increasingly targets Hong Kong, the police launches a risky and top-secret sting operation to bring down one of the most notorious drug lords in Asia. (警方发动了一场冒险、绝密的刺杀行动, 以击垮亚洲最臭名昭著的毒枭之一。)

programme.title: Someone Like Me (像我这样的人)
programme.desc: Mui, who lives with cerebral palsy, longs for connection and meets volunteer Kin. As their wounded souls grow closer, she begins to rethink love and her self-worth beyond the limits of her body, discovering the courage to embrace life and intimacy on her own terms.

programme.title: Moscow Mission ((警察学校7：进军莫斯科))
programme.desc: The story is based on a 1993 true event, the China-Russia Train Robbery where a gang of criminals commits a heist, stealing cash and goods from the cross border train. A Chinese police officer disguises as a businessman heads the operation to arrest the criminals, but uncovers a bigger conspiracy instead (故事的根据是1993年发生的一次真实事件,即中俄火车抢劫,一帮罪犯抢劫一帮罪犯抢劫,从跨境火车上偷盗现金和货物。 中国一名警察伪装成商人,领导逮捕罪犯的行动,但发现了更大的阴谋。)

programme.title: Hit N Fun ((临时决斗))
programme.desc: Former Muay Thai legend Zhong Lei trains pro fighters despite his gyms struggles. When ad executive Lin learns her boyfriend is cheating with a champion boxer, she challenges her rival to a match and undergoes brutal training under Zhong. Through the grueling process, Lins quest for revenge transforms into a journey of self-discovery. (前泰国传奇人物Zhong Lei不顾体操斗争而训练亲战者。 当Lin执行官得知她的男朋友与拳击冠军作弊时,她挑战对手,在钟中接受残酷训练。 林斯通过痛苦的过程,复仇的追求转变成了自我发现之旅。)

programme.title: The Invisible Guest ((看不见的客人))
programme.desc: Young and beautiful entrepreneur Joanna is a prime suspect in a locked-room murder where her lover is found dead. She pays off a police officer to prove her innocence. During the investigation, they discover another murder case involving Joanna and her lover, and eventually reveals the truth.

programme.title: Let It Ghost ((打架吧鬼神))
programme.desc: The movie consists of three urban ghost stories: when a film crew is haunted by a ghost, the director decides to cast her to play the ghost when a taxi driver takes his girlfriend to a staycation, a horny ghost adds spice to it a wandering child ghost refuses to leave a mall that is to be demolished, so the tenants help her to move on.

programme.title: Limbo ((丛林地狱))
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of brutal murders committed by a serial killer. Veteran detective Cham and rookie cop Will are assigned to the case. During the investigation, they encounter Wang Tao, who accidentally killed Chams wife. Seeking redemption, Wang assists them in tracking down the killer, but her involvement puts her in grave danger. (香港受到连环杀手一系列残忍谋杀的震撼。 退伍军人侦探Cham和新警察Will被指派负责此案。 在调查期间,他们遇到不小心杀害Cham Tao妻子的王涛。 寻求救赎,王氏协助他们追踪凶手,但她的参与使她处于严重危险之中。)

programme.title: The Unwavering Brotherhood ((扎职3：义薄云天))
programme.desc: The revered elder of a triad gang faces succession uncertainty when his three trusted underlingsHua, Fei, and Guoare robbed while transporting gang money. Determined to redeem himself, Hua vows to track down the robbers. However, when Hua discovers that Fei and Guo are connected to the robbery, he must choose between loyalty and brotherhood.

programme.title: Love is the only Answer ((人约离婚后))
programme.desc: At Bo and Cheong wedding reception, the projected was initially showing their journey of love, but suddenly a flash of a clip of Cheong and a sexy girl being intimate came up. Bo calmly ran up to the stage and announced that the wedding is cancelled. The incident rapidly became a hot topic on the internet. Within a year, back to being single again, Bo and the living life happily Cheong maintains a good relationship. One day, Cheong decided to play with love and took Bo to participate in a swinging party. The conservative Bo initially wanted to leave, but after being bribed by Cheong, she helpless and stayed. At the swinging party, the two encounter Kit and his wife Man Lai. The 4 of them develop a romantic and hot relationship... At another wedding reception, when the projector plays the groom and brides heartwarming clips, a flash of another clip that does not want to be seen comes up...

programme.title: My Indian Boyfriend (我印度男朋友)
programme.desc: This is a love story between a Hong Kong girl and an Indian boy and is the first Bollywood movie to be made in Hong Kong. It encapsulates the conflicts caused by discrimination as well as differences in social-cultural background, lifestyle and family values between the races. The movie also combines tears, joy and laughter with song and dance.

programme.title: Detective Dee And Nine-storey Demon Building
programme.desc: A series of strange incidents happen at the Tangs demon building but Detective Dee finds no clue. Dee finds the master of the family suspicious when he speaks with him, and when the eldest daughter Miss Tang secretly informs Dee about Mr Tangs strange behavior and the fact that she is kept under surveillance, Dee vows to unveil the truth.

programme.title: A Gilded Game ((猎金游戏))
programme.desc: Ambitious finance student Gao lands an internship as his friends family business prepares to go public in H.K. Under the mentorship of top analyst Zhang, his swift rise is soon undone by greed. After betraying Zhang for a rival, Gao puts his friends company in jeopardy. To redeem himself, he must seek help from Zhang to stop a hostile takeover. (高高明的金融野心学生高高明在其朋友的家族生意准备在H.K.公开的时候,当他的朋友家族生意准备在H.K.公开的时候,高高明就投身实习。 在高官分析师张明的引导下,他的迅速崛起很快因贪婪而倒闭。 高高明在背叛张氏竞争对手后,将朋友公司置于危险之中。 为了赎罪,他必须寻求张明的帮助以阻止敌对的接管。)

programme.title: The Chinese Feast ((金玉满堂))
programme.desc: Sun wants to start a new life as a chef in Canada and struggles to learn cooking skills from a restaurant owner, Au. While Sun will represent his restaurant to participate in a cooking competition, his skill is not good enough, and he has to seek help from a legendary master chef in order to win the ultimate challenge.

programme.title: Kung Fu Hustle ((功夫))
programme.desc: Mobster Sing aspires to join the Axe Gang. As he stumbles into a slum ruled by eccentric landlords that are kung fu masters in disguise, his actions cause the gang and the landlords to engage in an explosive kung fu battle (Mobster Sing 渴望加入Axe帮。 当他跌入一个由以拳法大师为幌子的 以心为本的房东统治的贫民窟时, 他的行动导致黑帮和房东 进行一场爆炸性功夫战斗)

programme.title: Haunted Mountains: The Yellow Taboo ((山忌：黄衣小飞侠))
programme.desc: A photographer and his friends venture into a remote mountain for a photo shoot, unaware they have entered a forbidden area. As eerie incidents unfold, a mysterious boy in a yellow raincoat who leaps through the forest appears, leading them to uncover an ancient curse and terrifying secrets hidden deep within the mountain.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood ((宝贝计划))
programme.desc: The infamous Gang Trio is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three Rob-B-Hood must put the baby safely back in his cradle. (臭名昭著的三驾马车被雇用绑架婴儿3000万。 当他们发现三驾马车打算抢夺赎金并杀害孩子时,他们把婴儿放在他们的翅膀下。 在被警察包围和黑帮追捕的情况下,三个Rob-B-Hood必须把婴儿安全地放回他的摇篮里。)

programme.title: One More Chance ((多一次机会))
programme.desc: A gambling-addicted Fai is entrusted by his ex-girlfriend to care for their autistic son. What begins as a chaotic father-son relationship gradually becomes a journey of mutual redemption, helping him rediscover himself. When he discovers his sons talent for running, Fai resolves to leave the past behind and support his son in pursuing his dreams. (博成的Fai被他的前女朋友委托照顾他们的自闭症儿子.从一个混乱的父亲-儿子关系开始,逐渐变成了相互赎回的旅程,帮助他重新发现自己.)

programme.title: The Singing Killer ((小煞星))
programme.desc: Chiang Yi is blackmailed into a jewellery heist by his former boss who threatens to expose his shady past. Complications arise when Chiang Yi discovers his first love working in the jewellery store. (易被他的前老板勒索,他威胁要揭露他的阴暗过去.)

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities ((港澳传奇))
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gamblers apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities. (李汉写了这部迷人而迷人的喜剧"两座城市的禁故事".这两个城市是澳门,爱情四人奏是性娱乐的道德不健康来源,香港,一个女人进入一个博家的公寓,发现四个链挂在天花板上,以帮助他做出恶意活动.)

programme.title: Martial Club ((武馆))
programme.desc: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other. This is Director Liu Chia Liangs masterpiece and one of the top ten highest grossing movies in 1981.

programme.title: Gamblers Delight ((流氓千王))
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off! (杀手明星丹尼·李扮演一个需要成为英雄的男人的主角. 他撒谎,偷窃和欺骗自己运营一个豪华的场,)

programme.title: Sunset ((落日))
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywoods famous Beach Party movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: The Shaolin Avengers ((八国联军))
programme.desc: Hu seeks to avenge his father who is being killed by the White-Browed Hermit and his gang. However, he fails in his attempt and is saved by Fang Shi Yu, a youth from Shaolin whose parents are also killed by the same villains. They learn and master the advanced Shaolin style kung fu, before Fang leads Hu and the Shaolin fellows to fight the enemies. (胡寻求报复他的父亲,他被白的子和他的帮派杀害.然而,他失败了他的尝试,被 Shi Yu,一个来自沙olin的年轻人拯救出来.他的父母也被同样的恶棍杀害.他们学习和掌握了先进的沙olin风格的功夫,然后领导胡和沙olin的同伙们去对抗敌人.)

programme.title: My Name Aint Suzie ((花街时代))
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on. (年轻的梅丽在万市工作为酒吧女生,以谋生.当她在酒吧里遇到吉米时,她认为他是她的真正爱人,并疯狂地爱上他.当吉米必须离开时,梅丽很丧.直到她遇到三人团的老板,她终于找到了一个可以依靠的人.)

programme.title: The Flying Dagger ((飞刀又见飞刀))
programme.desc: The Yu family and the Green Dragon clan became enemies when the Yu daughter killed the clan heads son, who was a rapist and murderer. The Green Dragon leader wounds the head of the Yu family with his flying daggers, and a wandering swordsman saves the family using his own flying dagger skills. However, his allegiances and motives are unclear. (家族和绿龙族成为敌人,当时女杀害了族长的儿子,他是强奸犯和杀手.绿龙领袖用飞行的刀伤了家族的头,一名流浪剑手用自己的飞行刀技巧拯救了家庭.然而,他的忠诚和动机尚不清楚.)

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow ((倩女幽魂))
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demons clutches. (一位年轻学者宁在一个可怕的寺里度过了晚上.据说是鬼鬼的.他不相信谣言,但很快遇到了一个美丽的女鬼尼.尼被迫留在寺里,以诱惑年轻人,让一个强大的恶魔吃饭.知道尼是一个善良的鬼,宁决定帮助她摆脱恶魔的抓住.)

programme.title: The Singing Thief ((大盗歌王))
programme.desc: A master jewel thief turns over a new leaf as a professional singer in a nightclub. However, a series of robberies happened shortly after and he becomes the suspect again. The thief then sets up a trap to snare the copycat but will this backfire on him? (一个杰出珠宝盗窃者在夜总会上作为一名专业歌手转换了新页面.然而,不久之后发生了一系列抢劫事件,他再次成为嫌疑人.)

programme.title: The Blue and the Black ((罗密欧的蓝天))
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return

programme.title: Wits Of The Brats ((南斗官三斗北少爷))
programme.desc: Nan Tou Kuan, a spoiled but talented young heir from Guangdong, is sent to Beijing by his mother to find a bride and mature. Along the way, he befriends three rogues: a cardsharp, a ladies man, and a master thief. Together, they must outwit the sinister Three-Eyed Taoist, who plots to seize the familys fortune.

programme.title: Facets Of Love ((北地胭脂))
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: Rolls, Rolls, I Love You ((卒仔抽车))
programme.desc: Three young men offend a billionaire and are drawn into a high stakes bet. If they win, they get to keep the billionaires Rolls Royce. Otherwise, they will need to pay the rich man fifty thousand dollars! Will the underdogs win the bet? (三个年轻人冒犯了一位亿万富翁,被引入一个高投注的投注.如果他们赢得,他们可以保留亿万富翁的罗尔斯罗伊斯.否则,他们必须支付富人五万美元!)

programme.title: We Love Millionaires ((我爱金龟婿))
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires or fake ones!. (在这部浪漫喜剧中,三个美丽的香港卖家女士前往日本大阪,追求他们嫁给一个富人的梦想.)

programme.title: The Duel ((怪兽雄师))
programme.desc: After knowing his brother has killed the head of a rival triad, Jie takes the blame and was hunted by killers. With the help of Rambler Nan, Jie finally killed his enemies, but then found out that Nan is the one who has killed his father. (在知道他的兄弟杀死了一个竞争对手三级的头之后,承担了责任,被杀手追捕.)

programme.title: Five Elements Ninjas ((五遁忍术))
programme.desc: After a Japanese samurai is defeated and commits seppuku, ninja lord Chin leads his clan to China for revenge. They challenge martial arts leader Yuan with the deadly Five Elements Ninja Formation, wiping out his unprepared disciples. The survivors must master the enemys techniques to break the formation and avenge their comrades.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom? ((女校春色))
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls high school, is stuck with a baby that isnt his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: Clan Feuds ((大旗英雄传))
programme.desc: Tie Zhong Tang, adopted son of Da Chi Men leader Yun Yi, is hunted by rival Situ Xiao, who seeks the clans hidden treasure. To uncover its secrets, Tie journeys to Changchun Island to find the legendary Ri Hou. Instead, he finds Ri Hou dead and discovers the clans founder, Ye Di Tie Yi, is his real father.

programme.title: West Chamber ((西厢艳谭))
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her familys objection, so Hongs maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber! (故事以中国著名歌剧为基础。 一位贫困的年轻学者张小明被他在一个神庙里相遇的有影响力的家庭的女儿洪家所迷惑。 年轻夫妇因为家人反对而面临分居的威胁,因此香港女佣秘密帮助安排他们在西厅的聚会!)

programme.title: Judgement Of An Assassin ((决杀令))
programme.desc: An evil clan plans a discord so as to dominate the martial arts world. Their masked assassins massacre another clan and one of the assassins is arrested and brought to trial at a tribunal of all the clans. What judgement will they make and can they uncover the truth? (一个邪恶的族群计划争端,以统治武术世界.他们的伪装杀手屠杀另一个族群,一个杀手被捕并被绳之以法.)

programme.title: Empress Wu ((唐朝禁宫秘史))
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperors death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor. (泽天是唐皇帝14岁的美丽和才华横溢的女神.她在唐皇帝去世后成为修道女,但与新皇帝唐高宗生了两个儿子.皇帝女士要求与她合作,反对夫人,但被设置并推翻了王位,他也杀了她的两个儿子.)

programme.title: Twin Blades Of Doom ((阴阳刀))
programme.desc: A retired martial artist is forced to return with a vengeance after his family and friends are murdered by the evil Ghost Gang. He decides to challenge the gangs leader to a deadly duel so as to take revenge. Can he defeat the ruthless leader in the end? (一位退休武术师被恶鬼帮杀害后,他的家人和朋友被迫回来报复.他决定挑战帮派领导人进行致命的决斗,以报复.他最终能击败这个无情的领导人吗?)

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion ((八国联军))
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing. (女皇西西认为拳击手声称他们开发了一种对武器不易使用的功夫,从而对八个外国国家的联盟宣战.清政府缺乏武器和良好的领导力使八个国家联盟能够击败北京.)

programme.title: Crazy Nuts Of Kung Fu ((鬼马两金刚))
programme.desc: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to make money from gambling. In a successful attempt to steal a huge amount of money from a warlords home, they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. Will the two help the revolutionists cause with the stolen money?

Fatso and Stretch just cannot stand Stinkys horrible smell for one single minute longer and they hatch a plan. They decide to wait for Stinky to fall asleep and then vacuum up the dreaded stink right out of Stinky. It works! the bad smell goes into the hoover bag but as the uncles start arguing, the bag bursts open and the bad smell escapes! The smell collides with Casper while hes going through the Dimension Tube to get back to Scare School and now its CASPER whos the stinky one. Jimmy cant resist fiddling with EVERYTHING! - and as Jimmy pulls the wrong chain three times in a row he and the manor are sucked into the tube and shrunken down to the size of a hand! Casper has a massive problem on his hands as the little tiny house with the little tiny munchkin inside it causes a huge stir at Scare School and its all Caspers fault! Thatch becomes more unbearable than ever as the kids at Scare School start to treat him like the biggest hero ever, totally putting him on a pedestal of sickening adoration.. Luckily, Caspers nose is blocked by a cold so he is the only student immune to the perfumes spell! He is also the only one who can fix his mistake! programme.title: NCIS 시즌8
programme.desc: 최고의 특수 요원들이 미 해군과 해병대에 관련된 모든 범죄를 수사하는 과정을 흥미진진하게 담은 범죄 수사물. 지난 시즌7부터 시즌8까지 매회 전미 시청률 1위를 기록하며 폭발적인 인기를 얻고 있는 작품이다. 특히 이번에 방송되는 시즌8은 미국에서도 지난 9월말 첫방송을 시작, 현지에서 인기리에 방송중인 최신작으로, 국내 시청자들도 미국 시청자들과 큰 격차없이 안방극장에서 만나볼 수 있다고. 진지한 범죄 수사과정 속에서 독특하고 개성 넘치는 캐릭터들의 유머 코드가 결합해, 색다른 범죄수사물로 자리잡으며 시청자들의 뜨거운 관심을 받고 있다.

programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.desc: 100세를 넘기는 장수 인류 센테네리언! 지금은 평균 기대수명 100세 시대, 인류의 수명을 끌어올린 생명 연장의 원동력을 찾아서 당신의 몸 속 장수 세포를 깨울 세계 각국 무병장수 건강법! 그 속에 감춰진 놀라운 슈퍼 푸드의 힘을 만나본다.

programme.title: 신중한 강연쇼
programme.desc: 5천년 중국 역사 비틀기부터 2016년 현재 중국의 민낯까지! ALL ABOUT CHINA! 지금까지 당신이 알고 있던 중국은 잊어라! 중국과 한국의 명사들에게 듣는 중국인도 모르는 중국의 진짜 이야기! quot표절 천국이냐 한류를 넘어선 콘텐츠 강국이냐, 대륙의 문화 콘텐츠의 민낯은? 슈퍼 차이나인가 차이나쇼크인가? 미래의 차이나 리포트는?quot 당신이 모르던 진짜 중국에 대한 이야기를 들려준다. 한중 대표 지식인 6인의 버라이어티 강연쇼! 같은 주제에 다른 시각 또는 각자의 관점으로 이야기 하라! 신중한 강연쇼는 통찰력으로 무장한 한국과 중국의 지성 교양인 6인이 출연하여 매회 한국 대툐와 중국 대표 강연자가 한가지 테마를 두고 강연을 펼친다. 다양한 테마는 기본, 한중 양국의 다채로운 시선과 생각을 공유할 수 있는 새로운 형식의 버라이어티 강연쇼로 시청자들에게 다가갈 수 있을 것이다.
